description:
Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California with team members located across the globe. Learn more at bitwarden.com. 

Machine identities now outnumber human ones in most enterprises, and the gap is widening as AI agents take on real work with real credentials. Bitwarden Secrets Manager is how developers and DevOps teams store, rotate, and deliver the machine credentials, API keys, and infrastructure secrets that keep their systems running. 

THE ROLE

Bitwarden is looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to lead go-to-market for Bitwarden Secrets Manager and our developer-focused solutions. In this role, you will be the market expert for Secrets Manager and Bitwarden’s voice in the developer ecosystem. You will shape positioning and messaging, bring new features to market, and help developers, DevOps/DevSecOps teams, and technical decision-makers understand why Bitwarden is the right choice for securing development workflows and agentic workloads. You will work closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing.

This is an all-remote team and we’re looking for someone located in the U.S. We do not offer visa sponsorship at this time. 

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own product marketing and go-to-market, including positioning, messaging, competitive intelligence, sales enablement, and product launches, for Bitwarden Secrets Manager and solutions supporting developers and DevOps/DevSecOps teams
  • Serve as a dedicated product expert with a deep understanding of the Secrets Manager product and how it is used to secure development workflows and agentic workloads
  • Partner closely with the Secrets Manager Product Manager, bringing market, competitive, and customer insight into roadmap, pricing, and packaging decisions
  • Own the developer side of Bitwarden’s agentic security narrative, in line with the company’s broader agentic identity strategy
  • Shape Bitwarden’s point of view on securing developer workflows and agentic workloads through thought leadership in content and events
  • Translate complex topics such as secrets management, machine identities, and agentic security into clear, compelling messaging that shows differentiated value
  • Build content and demos that showcase how Bitwarden supports developer workflows and that resonate with developers, DevOps teams, and technical decision-makers 
  • Equip Sales and Customer Success with training, sales assets, competitive content, and talk tracks that support value-based conversations and connect technical capabilities to customer outcomes
  • Participate in developer communities, technical forums, and industry events to grow Bitwarden’s presence in the developer ecosystem
  • Engage in analyst briefings and customer and partner conversations on DevOps/DevSecOps and emerging engineering practices
  • Measure the impact of go-to-market work through pipeline generation, win rates, expansion, and product adoption, and use that data to sharpen messaging, content, and tactics, focusing effort where it moves the business
  • Help build the team’s AI practice in product marketing, sharing workflows and approaches that improve speed and quality

WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN

  • 7+ years of B2B SaaS product marketing experience, with at least 5 years marketing to developer, DevOps, or DevSecOps audiences
  • Experience marketing cybersecurity or identity products preferred
  • Strong track record marketing technically deep products, such as secrets management, non-human identity management, or CI/CD and automation tooling
  • Proven success launching technically complex products to developer and DevOps audiences
  • Experience engaging with developer communities or contributing to developer evangelism programs
  • Hands-on familiarity with developer-facing technologies such as SDKs, APIs, CLIs, and open source tooling
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to speed up research, competitive analysis, messaging development, and content creation, with the judgment to know where AI helps and where human insight has to lead
  • Collaborative and adaptable mindset
  • Openness and authenticity combined with excellent communication skills
  • Excitement and enthusiasm for open source and for better internet security 
  • Excellent problem-solving skills: you might not know all the answers, but you know how to find and communicate the solution

WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Meeting with Talent Acquisition 
  • Interview with Senior Director, Product Marketing (hiring manager)
  • Interview with Senior Product Marketing Manager
  • Interview with Director of New Products
  • Take home assignment and presentation
  • Interview with Chief Product Officer
  • Reference calls

A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US

  • Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.
  • Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software.
  • We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world.
  • Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team, and join our #growth-club to continue personal and professional development. 

In the United States, the starting base compensation range for this role is $150,000 - $185,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, relevant experience, and skill set as assessed in the interview process, as well as market data by location. See our careers page for a list of benefits. Please note that compensation outside the U.S. will differ based on the market.
